command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=${CONDA_PREFIX:-/opt/conda}/bin:$PATH HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out /tmp/desi/desiutil
cd /tmp
printf 'c40e00a0162f3769712dbb7d3489afd3c210faaabd137dc314bc5dd044460583  probe_flip.py\n1ae2b63d3d95a0d76adc7a7a274a6c623b79dd972a12cf193fffcf52c5ccc589  desiutil_log.py\n2d49a47e7f95d1b8630c2e5b57b690a60404e75f309121da2b7915c1e14ac26e  sfd.sha256\ned51e9c567fdd3061e14889a6ff6c453c0bb2e0a442310f567f5122f14556678  desispec_emlinefit.py\n4649129279f59732bb74174bc2202369ffc9bbf10b52fa65e1c158746d1c4ddf  desiutil_dust.py\n' > scripts.sha256
sha256sum -c scripts.sha256 || { echo 'FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin'; exit 1; }
( cd /work/sfd && sha256sum -c /tmp/sfd.sha256 ) || { echo 'FAIL: SFD pin'; exit 1; }
cp desispec_emlinefit.py /tmp/desi/desispec_iron_emlinefit.py; cp desiutil_dust.py /tmp/desi/; cp desiutil_log.py /tmp/desi/desiutil/log.py; : > /tmp/desi/desiutil/__init__.py
python3 -u /tmp/probe_flip.py /work/in /work/sfd > /tmp/out/probe.txt 2>&1; cat /tmp/out/probe.txt
grep -q 'PROBE DONE' /tmp/out/probe.txt || { echo FAIL; exit 1; }
